# Requirements Document: The verified design system

## Introduction

The tokens and rules every screen must follow. Documentation, code and UI checks are generated from the same Lean model.

Each criterion carries where it comes from. *modelled* means the sentence was computed by running the model. *proven* means Lean checked a theorem for every input, shown with its statement. *open question* means the model shows a problem and someone has to decide.

## Requirements

### Requirement DS-001

**User Story:** As an expert on a phone in bright light, I want every screen to be readable, so that I can answer anywhere.

### Requirement DS-002

**Title:** Colour pairs that are forbidden

**User Story:** As a designer, I want the model to stop pairs that cannot pass, so that a brand colour is not misused.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. IF red would be used for graphics on delta-blue THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as a defect, because it measures below 3.00 to 1.
   - DS-002.1, proven
   - Theorem `forbidden_pairs_fail` (model/Design/Rules.lean:30)
   - Lean: `Design.forbiddenPairs.all Design.Pair.fails = true`
2. IF red would be used for text on delta-blue THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as a defect, because it measures below 4.50 to 1.
   - DS-002.2, proven
   - Theorem `forbidden_pairs_fail` (model/Design/Rules.lean:30)
   - Lean: `Design.forbiddenPairs.all Design.Pair.fails = true`
3. IF bright would be used for graphics on navy THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as a defect, because it measures below 3.00 to 1.
   - DS-002.3, proven
   - Theorem `forbidden_pairs_fail` (model/Design/Rules.lean:30)
   - Lean: `Design.forbiddenPairs.all Design.Pair.fails = true`
4. IF bright would be used for graphics on delta-blue THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as a defect, because it measures below 3.00 to 1.
   - DS-002.4, proven
   - Theorem `forbidden_pairs_fail` (model/Design/Rules.lean:30)
   - Lean: `Design.forbiddenPairs.all Design.Pair.fails = true`
5. IF red would be used for graphics on navy-raised THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as a defect, because it measures below 3.00 to 1.
   - DS-002.5, proven
   - Theorem `forbidden_pairs_fail` (model/Design/Rules.lean:30)
   - Lean: `Design.forbiddenPairs.all Design.Pair.fails = true`
6. IF red would be used for text on ice THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL treat it as a defect, because it measures below 4.50 to 1.
   - DS-002.6, proven
   - Theorem `forbidden_pairs_fail` (model/Design/Rules.lean:30)
   - Lean: `Design.forbiddenPairs.all Design.Pair.fails = true`
7. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep the forbidden and allowed lists apart.
   - DS-002.7, proven
   - Theorem `no_pair_is_both_allowed_and_forbidden` (model/Design/Rules.lean:35)
   - Lean: `(Design.allowedPairs.all fun p => !Design.forbiddenPairs.contains p) = true`

### Requirement DS-003

**Title:** Telling results apart

**User Story:** As an expert with low colour vision, I want results to differ in more than hue, so that I can tell them apart.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep every two result grounds at least 1.25 to 1 apart in lightness.
   - DS-003.1, proven
   - Theorem `result_grounds_differ_in_lightness` (model/Design/Rules.lean:53)
   - Lean: `(Design.resultGrounds.all fun a => Design.resultGrounds.all fun b => a == b || decide (Design.surfaceBar ≤ Design.contrastLow a.color b.color)) = true`
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL show the red ground for the biggest moments and for nothing else.
   - DS-003.2, proven
   - Theorem `red_means_the_biggest_moment` (model/Design/Rules.lean:87)
   - Lean: `∀ (o : Game.Outcome), Design.surfaceOf o = Design.Surface.possibleCatch ↔ o.loudness = 3`
3. WHEN an expert misses a check card THE SYSTEM SHALL show the ordinary asking ground.
   - DS-003.3, proven
   - Theorem `missed_check_shows_nothing` (model/Design/Rules.lean:92)
   - Lean: `Design.surfaceOf Game.Outcome.checkMissed = Design.Surface.asking`

### Requirement DS-004

**Title:** Touch and focus

**User Story:** As an expert using one thumb or a keyboard, I want controls I can reach and see, so that I never mis-tap.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL make a choice 112 pixels tall.
   - DS-004.1, modelled
   - Read by running `controls` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:130), and checked in every engine by the vectors
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL make a option 56 pixels tall.
   - DS-004.2, modelled
   - Read by running `controls` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:130), and checked in every engine by the vectors
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL make a pill 48 pixels tall.
   - DS-004.3, modelled
   - Read by running `controls` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:130), and checked in every engine by the vectors
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL make a primary button 64 pixels tall.
   - DS-004.4, modelled
   - Read by running `controls` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:130), and checked in every engine by the vectors
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL make a text link 44 pixels tall.
   - DS-004.5, modelled
   - Read by running `controls` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:130), and checked in every engine by the vectors
6. THE SYSTEM SHALL make every control at least 44 pixels tall.
   - DS-004.6, proven
   - Theorem `controls_meet_touch_target` (model/Design/Rules.lean:58)
   - Lean: `(Design.controls.all fun x => decide (Design.minTouchTarget ≤ x.height)) = true`
7. THE SYSTEM SHALL show the focus ring on every surface.
   - DS-004.7, proven
   - Theorem `focus_ring_shows_on_every_surface` (model/Design/Rules.lean:42)
   - Lean: `(Design.Surface.all.all fun s => { fg := s.focusRing, bg := s.ground, use := Design.Use.graphic }.passes) = true`

### Requirement DS-005

**Title:** Type

**User Story:** As an expert, I want the case to be the largest thing I read, so that a review takes no effort.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. THE SYSTEM SHALL set display text at 62 pixels.
   - DS-005.1, modelled
   - Read by running `TypeRole.px` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:122), and checked in every engine by the vectors
2. THE SYSTEM SHALL set heading text at 48 pixels.
   - DS-005.2, modelled
   - Read by running `TypeRole.px` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:122), and checked in every engine by the vectors
3. THE SYSTEM SHALL set case text at 27 pixels.
   - DS-005.3, modelled
   - Read by running `TypeRole.px` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:122), and checked in every engine by the vectors
4. THE SYSTEM SHALL set body text at 17 pixels.
   - DS-005.4, modelled
   - Read by running `TypeRole.px` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:122), and checked in every engine by the vectors
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL set label text at 14 pixels.
   - DS-005.5, modelled
   - Read by running `TypeRole.px` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:122), and checked in every engine by the vectors
6. THE SYSTEM SHALL never set text below 13 pixels.
   - DS-005.6, proven
   - Theorem `type_is_never_too_small` (model/Design/Rules.lean:60)
   - Lean: `(Design.TypeRole.all.all fun x => decide (Design.minTextPx ≤ x.px)) = true`
7. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep each step of the type scale smaller than the one above.
   - DS-005.7, proven
   - Theorem `type_scale_descends` (model/Design/Rules.lean:62)
   - Lean: `Design.TypeRole.display.px > Design.TypeRole.heading.px ∧ Design.TypeRole.heading.px > Design.TypeRole.caseText.px ∧ Design.TypeRole.caseText.px > Design.TypeRole.body.px ∧ Design.TypeRole.body.px > Design.TypeRole.label.px`

### Requirement DS-006

**Title:** Motion

**User Story:** As an expert sensitive to motion, I want animation to be short and to go away when I ask, so that the game stays usable.

#### Acceptance Criteria

1. WHEN stamp-landing plays THE SYSTEM SHALL finish in 180 ms, or in 0 ms when the person asks for reduced motion.
   - DS-006.1, modelled
   - Read by running `motions` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:143), and checked in every engine by the vectors
2. WHEN card-exit plays THE SYSTEM SHALL finish in 220 ms, or in 0 ms when the person asks for reduced motion.
   - DS-006.2, modelled
   - Read by running `motions` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:143), and checked in every engine by the vectors
3. WHEN ground-change plays THE SYSTEM SHALL finish in 160 ms, or in 0 ms when the person asks for reduced motion.
   - DS-006.3, modelled
   - Read by running `motions` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:143), and checked in every engine by the vectors
4. WHEN rookie-react plays THE SYSTEM SHALL finish in 240 ms, or in 0 ms when the person asks for reduced motion.
   - DS-006.4, modelled
   - Read by running `motions` (model/Design/Tokens.lean:143), and checked in every engine by the vectors
5. THE SYSTEM SHALL keep every animation at or under 300 ms.
   - DS-006.5, proven
   - Theorem `motions_stay_short` (model/Design/Rules.lean:67)
   - Lean: `(Design.motions.all fun x => decide (x.ms ≤ Design.maxMotionMs)) = true`
6. WHEN a person asks for reduced motion THE SYSTEM SHALL remove every animation.
   - DS-006.6, proven
   - Theorem `reduced_motion_removes_animation` (model/Design/Rules.lean:69)
   - Lean: `(Design.motions.all fun x => x.reducedMs == 0) = true`
